access_review.scope: Gift lets you promise an opponent a gift while casting a spell. For an instant or sorcery, they receive it before the spell's other effects as it resolves; for a permanent, a triggered ability gives the gift when it enters.

W.note: Bilbo's Gambit returns a spell to its owner's hand; promising its Treasure gift also prevents players from casting spells that turn.

access_review.scope: A goaded creature attacks each combat if able and attacks a player other than the controller of the permanent, spell, or ability that goaded it if able. Goad normally lasts until the next turn of the spell or ability's controller; continuous effects or explicit durations can differ.
access_review.summary: A goaded creature attacks each combat if able and attacks a player other than the controller of the permanent, spell, or ability that goaded it if able. Goad normally lasts until the next turn of the spell or ability's controller; continuous effects or explicit durations can differ.

Bhaal, Lord of Murder puts a +1/+1 counter on a creature and goads it whenever another nontoken creature you control dies.
Bjorna, Nightfall Alchemist taps and sacrifices an artifact to deal 1 damage to a creature and goad it.
Frenzied Gorespawn's entry trigger goads one target creature controlled by each opponent.
Kaima, the Fractured Calm goads each opponent's creature enchanted by an Aura you control at the start of your end step, gaining a +1/+1 counter for each.
Killian, Decisive Mentor can tap and goad a creature whenever an enchantment you control enters.
Kitt Kanto, Mayhem Diva lets you tap two untapped creatures you control at the start of combat on each player's turn to give one of that player's creatures +2/+2 and trample, then goad it.
Kros, Defense Contractor taps and goads a creature you don't control whenever you put counters on it, also giving it trample until your next turn.
Maestros Confluence offers a mode that goads every creature controlled by a target player.
Nelly Borca, Impulsive Accuser suspects a target creature when she attacks, then goads all suspected creatures.
Rendmaw, Creaking Nest gives each player a tapped Bird when it enters or you play a card with two or more card types; those tokens stay goaded for the rest of the game.
